question: How many days do customers have to return unused items?
expected_quotes: Customers may return unused items within 30 days of delivery.

question: Who covers the postage when I send back something I simply changed my mind about?
expected_quotes: For change-of-mind returns, a flat return label fee of 6.95 USD is deducted from the refund.
notes: decoy: returns-policy-2025 made the customer pay the full return shipping cost

question: What restocking fee applies to opened electronics?
expected_quotes: Opened electronics, such as GPS units and satellite messengers, carry a 15 percent restocking fee unless they are defective.
notes: decoy: returns-policy-2025 charged 20 percent on all opened items

question: Can a customer exchange an item for a different size?
expected_quotes: Each order includes one free exchange for a different size or color of the same item.

question: When was the 2025 returns policy superseded, and by which version?
expected_quotes: Superseded on 2026-01-15 by the Returns Policy version 2026-01.
notes: asks about the old decoy document itself

question: What are the payment terms with Alpinewood?
expected_quotes: Payment is due net 30 from the invoice date.
notes: decoy: Trailworks is net 45 with the same sentence shape; page 1

question: What are the payment terms with Trailworks?
expected_quotes: Payment is due net 45 from the invoice date.

question: What is the minimum order value for a Trailworks purchase order?
expected_quotes: The minimum order value is 4,000 USD per purchase order, measured before freight.
notes: decoy: Alpinewood minimum is 2,500 USD; page 1

question: What does Alpinewood owe Harbor Goods when a delivery is late?
expected_quotes: Alpinewood credits Harbor Goods 1 percent of the purchase order value for each full week of delay, capped at 5 percent of the purchase order value.
notes: decoy: Trailworks credits 2 percent per week capped at 10 percent; page 2

question: What is the standard lead time for Trailworks orders?
expected_quotes: The standard lead time is 35 calendar days from confirmation of the purchase order to delivery at the Harbor Goods warehouse.
notes: decoy: Alpinewood lead time is 21 calendar days; page 2

question: Do we get anything off if we settle an Alpinewood bill quickly?
expected_quotes: Harbor Goods may take a 2 percent early payment discount if it pays the full invoice within 10 days of the invoice date.
notes: decoy: Trailworks offers no early payment discount; page 1

question: How long does Harbor Goods have to report manufacturing defects to Trailworks?
expected_quotes: Harbor Goods reports manufacturing defects to Trailworks within 30 days of receipt.
notes: decoy: Alpinewood allows 14 days for defects found at receiving; page 3

question: How long are tents covered by the warranty?
expected_quotes: Tents and shelters are covered for 2 years from the date of delivery.

question: How long is the warranty on Harbor Line backpacks?
expected_quotes: Harbor Line backpacks, our own brand, are covered for 5 years from the date of delivery.
notes: page 1; other backpack brands get 1 year

question: My tent fabric was damaged by the sun after two seasons of use. Will the warranty pay for it?
expected_quotes: UV damage to tent fabrics is excluded after the first 12 months.

question: What happens to a warranty claim when the repair would cost too much?
expected_quotes: If the repair would cost more than 60 percent of the price paid, we replace the product with the same item or the closest current model.

question: Which form is used to make a warranty claim?
expected_quotes: Claims are made with warranty claim form WC-1, which is available from the customer account or from support.

question: How long does Harbor Goods keep order records?
expected_quotes: Order records, including invoices and payment records, are kept for 7 years after the end of the financial year in which the order was placed, to meet tax and accounting rules.

question: If I ask Harbor Goods to erase my personal information, how long until it is gone?
expected_quotes: Once the identity is verified, we complete the deletion within 30 days and send a confirmation email.

question: How long are backups of the order and customer systems kept?
expected_quotes: Backups of the order and customer systems are kept for 35 days.

question: What is the minimum order value for free shipping?
expected_quotes: Orders of 75 USD or more ship free by standard service to Zones 1 to 4.

question: How soon after I buy something does it leave the warehouse?
expected_quotes: Our handling time is 1 business day for in-stock items.
notes: peak season can extend this, see holiday-schedule

question: How much does a standard parcel to Zone 2 cost?
expected_quotes: Zone 2 parcels cost 8.40 USD each.

question: What is the remote-area surcharge, and does it apply when shipping is free?
expected_quotes: A remote-area surcharge of 6.50 USD per parcel applies to every parcel sent to a postal code on the remote-area list, even when the order qualifies for free shipping.

question: What is the heaviest single parcel NorthRoute Parcel will carry?
expected_quotes: NorthRoute Parcel carries single parcels weighing up to 30 lb.

question: Can two promo codes be used on the same order?
expected_quotes: Only one promo code can be used per order.

question: Once my returned item has been checked, how soon do I get my money back?
expected_quotes: Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the returned item passes inspection.
notes: decoy: returns-policy-2025 said 14 business days after arrival

question: Which chargebacks does the finance team accept without contesting them?
expected_quotes: Chargebacks for amounts under 25 USD are accepted without a contest, because the cost of responding is higher than the amount.

question: Who must approve a purchase order worth 12,000 USD?
expected_quotes: Purchase orders above 10,000 USD need approval from both the Operations Manager and the Finance Director.

question: What format do purchase order numbers use?
expected_quotes: Each PO gets a number in the format PO-2026-0001, counting up through the year.

question: What price difference is allowed in the three-way match?
expected_quotes: A price difference is accepted if it is no more than 2 percent of the line value or 50 USD, whichever is lower.

question: On which day of the week are supplier invoices paid?
expected_quotes: Payment runs take place every Thursday.

question: Do Harbor Goods gift cards expire?
expected_quotes: Gift card codes start with HGC followed by 12 digits, and gift cards never expire.

question: How often are class A SKUs counted?
expected_quotes: Class A SKUs are counted every week.

question: When does a stock count difference mean someone else has to count the bin again?
expected_quotes: A variance of more than 3 percent of the system quantity triggers a recount by a second counter.

question: How soon must visible transport damage on a supplier delivery be reported?
expected_quotes: Visible transport damage must be reported to the carrier and the supplier within 48 hours of delivery, with photos of the damaged cartons and contents.

question: How much empty space should a packer leave around the items when picking a box?
expected_quotes: Use the smallest box that leaves at least 2 inches of padding between the items and every side of the box.

question: How many photos must a customer send when reporting transit damage?
expected_quotes: The report must include at least 3 photos: one of the outer box, one of the packing inside, and one of the damaged item.

question: What is the first-response target for support emails?
expected_quotes: The first-response target for email is 4 business hours.

question: What is the last order day for standard delivery before Christmas 2026?
expected_quotes: The last order day for standard delivery is Wednesday 16 December 2026.

question: When is a Trailworks invoice due, and what late fee can Trailworks charge if Harbor Goods pays after that?
expected_quotes: Payment is due net 45 from the invoice date.
Suppliers may charge a late fee of 1.5 percent per month on any invoice amount that Harbor Goods pays after the due date.
notes: decoy: Alpinewood is net 30; Trailworks page 1

question: Who has to approve a purchase order placed at exactly the Alpinewood minimum order value?
expected_quotes: The minimum order value is 2,500 USD per purchase order, measured before freight.
Purchase orders above 1,000 USD and up to 10,000 USD need approval from the Operations Manager.
notes: decoy: Trailworks minimum is 4,000 USD; Alpinewood page 1

question: A customer orders 90 USD of gear by standard service to a Zone 3 postal code on the remote-area list. What do they pay for shipping?
expected_quotes: Orders of 75 USD or more ship free by standard service to Zones 1 to 4.
A remote-area surcharge of 6.50 USD per parcel applies to every parcel sent to a postal code on the remote-area list, even when the order qualifies for free shipping.
notes: free shipping applies but the surcharge does not go away

question: After a change-of-mind return reaches the warehouse, how soon is it inspected and what is deducted from the refund?
expected_quotes: For change-of-mind returns, a flat return label fee of 6.95 USD is deducted from the refund.
Returned items are inspected within 3 business days of arriving at the warehouse.
notes: decoy: returns-policy-2025 had different return shipping rules

question: How long is the customer warranty on Harbor Line backpacks, and for how long does Trailworks reimburse those claims?
expected_quotes: Harbor Line backpacks, our own brand, are covered for 5 years from the date of delivery.
Trailworks reimburses Harbor Goods for approved warranty claims on Trailworks products for up to 1 year from delivery to the customer, and for up to 5 years for Harbor Line backpacks.

question: What is the heaviest carton a packer may send with NorthRoute, and which carrier takes heavier shipments?
expected_quotes: A single carton must not weigh more than 30 lb, so that it can travel with NorthRoute Parcel.
Swiftline Freight carries shipments weighing from 30.1 lb to 150 lb, either as one heavy carton or as several cartons strapped together.

question: What is the normal handling time, and how long can it be during the 2026 peak season?
expected_quotes: Our handling time is 1 business day for in-stock items.
During peak season, handling time may extend to 2 business days, because order volume is several times higher than usual.

question: How long does a customer have to report a parcel that arrived broken, and how fast should support first reply to that ticket?
expected_quotes: Customers must report transit damage within 7 days of delivery.
Priority tickets get a first response within 2 business hours.
notes: a damaged order is a priority ticket

question: Which warehouse document must agree with the invoice before accounts payable pays a supplier, and when is it created?
expected_quotes: The invoice, the purchase order and the receiving report must agree on the items, quantities and prices.
The receiver enters a receiving report in the inventory system on the day of delivery, listing the quantity received in good condition for each SKU.

question: Are paid supplier invoices and customer order records kept for the same length of time?
expected_quotes: Paid invoices and their matching documents are stored in the finance system for 7 years.
Order records, including invoices and payment records, are kept for 7 years after the end of the financial year in which the order was placed, to meet tax and accounting rules.
